{{Quote|I can tell you where to find them... for a price.|Garindan|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref>}}
'''Garindan''', also called '''Long-Snoot''', was a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] who was considered to be the "greatest [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] spaceport."

==Biography==
{{Quote|Which way?|Mod Terrik to Garindan|<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Garindan_trooper.png|thumb|left|250px|Garindan, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] informant]]
With his face hidden beneath his dark hood, goggles and [[Insect/Legends|insect]]-eating snout, few on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] knew his origins. Many believed that he was wildly wealthy, though his vast amounts of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] were only seen when he paid for information. He was seen carrying the [[434 Deathhammer/Legends|Model 434 blaster pistol]], popular among [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].

Garindan's information was priceless, and his skills went to the highest bidder, whether it be to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] (who was wary of Garindan finding out too much about Jabba's business transactions) or to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]]. Garindan was apparently capable of finding out a wide variety of information, as evidenced when he gave the possible whereabouts to Jabba concerning the fabled [[Yavin Vassilika]].

Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]'' is set by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] take place, which corresponds to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Garindan visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], where he observed a [[Lightfight|shootout]] between [[Rff Huff]] and [[Purong]].<ref name="Cantina Pop-Up">''[[The Mos Eisley Cantina Pop-Up Book]]''</ref>

[[File:SearchingMosEisley-SWI145.jpg|thumb|Garindan with Zeta Squadron]]
Just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was hired by the local Imperial prefect to find two missing [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Once he discovered them, he followed the droids and their new owner to [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]] and called in a squad of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to attack. Despite this, the droids were able to escape, in part due to the help of stormtrooper [[Davin Felth/Legends|Davin Felth's]] betrayal when he shot his commanding officer in the back.

Afterward, Garindan met with the [[Ketton/Legends|Ketton]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Derrida/Legends|Derrida]] and conferred. The meeting was witnessed by [[Meysen Kayson|Meyser Kayson]]'s son, who reported it to the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

Garindan later was interrogated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] to discover the location of his cousin, [[Udin]]. He also discovered that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had sold a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], helping [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to confirm the origins and identity of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] destroyer. After the battle of Yavin Garindan went to Hoth. He had heard there where [[Jedi Hunters (Cularin)|Jedi Hunters]] hunting a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Garindan was paid by pirates to find the location of the Jedi. Garindan killed the crew of pirates and gave the information to the Jedi Hunters.

==Personality and traits==
Garindan's eyes were hidden beneath dark goggles, as they were extremely sensitive to the harsh sunlight of Tatooine. His name translated to "Blessed One," "Burnt wood," "dust from a windstorm," "ugly," and "toast" in five different languages.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Garindan_SWGTCG-AoD.jpg|thumb|200px|Garindan within the shadows of Mos Eisley]]
Garindan was played by [[Sadie Edon|Sadie Eddon]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]. His voice is a processed version of [[John Wayne]]'s.<ref name="Star Wars Insider 110">[[Star Wars Insider 110|''Star Wars Insider'' 110]]</ref>

In [[Star Wars (1977) 2|''Star Wars'' (1977) 2]], Garindan is portrayed as [[Human/Legends|Human]].

In both ''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]] and Lego Star Wars: The complete Saga,'' Garindan is referred to simply as "Imperial Spy" and is actually a boss in Episode IV chapter three, where you have to kill him to escape in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. He dresses up as a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] and infiltrates the award ceremony after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but is quickly discovered and led away.

You can play as him in both games without having to unlock or purchase him, as he is one of the few characters that you automatically have when you download the games. However, he carries no weapons. When the attack button is pressed, Garindan pulls a walkie-talkie and speaks into it, similar to his only appearance in ''A New Hope''.
